alignment: Order-free, per-code occurrence pairing (k-th occurrence of a code in kjv-osis pairs with the k-th in oshb). Matched pairs assert 'same lexeme attested in this verse', not word-order correspondence. Surplus occurrences become omissions/additions; the omissions themselves are exact. Excluded from alignment on both sides: tokens with no Strong's number (19 OSHB prefix-only words in Genesis 34) — counts and omissions cover coded tokens only. Quirk: scrollmapper sometimes merges the object marker H853 into a verb span (e.g. 'created' carries H853+H1254), so matched H853 pairs show the verb's English span against the standalone Hebrew word et.

sources.kjv-osis: scrollmapper tagged KJV (English spans; some lemmas merged)
sources.oshb: Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible (Hebrew words; complete tagging)
